extraContent.title: Morph Gauge
content: Kaiser has a gauge called the Morph Gauge that when fully filled, Kaiser can transform into their ultimate form (starting from 3rd Job). The gauge can be charged by attacking enemies

As well, Kaiser's attacks can be activated by command inputs using <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/dragon-link.png} tip={Dragon Link (Beginner Skill)}> Dragon Link. Using command input skills will charge the Morph Gauge faster and the attack will deal more damage. Below is a list of all commands:

<bp_<tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/flame-surge.png} tip={Flame Surge (1st Job)}> Flame Surge (1st Job): [Attack] -> <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/dragon-link.png} tip={Dragon Link (Beginner Skill)}>_<tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/impact-wave.png} tip={Impact Wave (2nd Job)}> Impact Wave (2nd Job): [Attack] -> [↑] + <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/dragon-link.png} tip={Dragon Link (Beginner Skill)}>_<tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/wing-beat.png} tip={Wing Beat (3rd Job)}> Wing Beat (3rd Job): [Attack] -> [Jump] + <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/dragon-link.png} tip={Dragon Link (Beginner Skill)}>_<tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/gigas-wave.png} tip={Gigas Wave (4th Job)}> Gigas Wave (4th Job): [Attack] -> <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/gigas-wave.png} tip={Gigas Wave (4th Job)}>_<tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/dragon-barrage.png} tip={Dragon Barrage (4th Job)}> Dragon Barrage (4th Job): [Attack] -> [→ or ←] + <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/dragon-link.png} tip={Dragon Link (Beginner Skill)}>_<tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/blade-burst.png} tip={Blade Burst (4th Job)}> Blade Burst (4th Job): [Attack] -> [↓] + <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/dragon-link.png} tip={Dragon Link (Beginner Skill)}>_>

primary.name: Iron Will
primary.shortDesc: Max HP: +15%, Damage increase per Morph Gauge Stage: +5%
details: Skill can be found in <tt src={/class-icons/link-skills/link-manager.png} tip={Link Manager (Beginner Skill)}>

primary.name: Realign: Defender Mode
primary.shortDesc: Defense: +200
details: Cannot be combined with <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/realign-attacker-mode.png} tip={Realign: Attacker Mode (Beginner Skill)}>

primary.name: Realign: Attacker Mode
primary.shortDesc: Attack Power: +5, Critical Rate: +3%, Boss Damage: +3%
details: Cannot be combined with <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/realign-defender-mode.png} tip={Realign: Defender Mode (Beginner Skill)}>

primary.name: Vertical Grapple
primary.shortDesc: Press the skill key while you're climbing to cancel.
primary.desc: Grapple onto a platform above and launch towards it
details: Pressing the Jump Key while launching up will cancel the grapple early

primary.name: Transfiguration
primary.shortDesc: Movement Speed +10, Jump +20, Knockback Resistance +40%

primary.name: Dragon Link
primary.shortDesc: Morph Gauge fills faster, and the Dragon Link skill and the Kaiser attack skill that follows will have their final damage increased by 15%. Once used, any buff that increases the final damage of following attack will disappear regardless of the skill. Does not apply to Wing Beat.
primary.desc: Allows you to use Attack Commands by combining this Skill Key with a unique combination of Keys
details: Activating skills using Attack Commands will charge the Morph Gauge faster and the attack will deal more damage

primary.name: Exclusive Spell
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 30, increases Attack Power & Magic ATT by 4% for 2400 sec\nCooldown: 300 sec
details: To obtain this skill, complete the quest <link href={https://maplestorywiki.net/w/Quests/22/Grand_Kaiser} title={"Grand Kaiser"}>

primary.name: Guardian's Return
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 100\nCooldown: 600 sec
primary.desc: Returns you to Pantheon, Kaiser's hometown

primary.name: Dragon Slash
primary.shortDesc:
1-hit: Attack up to 8 enemies for 70% damage 3 times
2-hit: Up to 6 enemies attack for 50% damage 5 times
3-hit: Up to 6 enemies attack for 60% damage 5 times
Final Form: Up to 8 enemies attack for 160% damage 5 times, Up to 10 enemies attack 6 times after 4th job
primary.desc: Attack forward consecutively up to 3 times

primary.name: Flame Surge
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 10, Damage: 170%, Number of Attacks: 2, Max Enemies Hit: 6
primary.desc: Launch fireballs forward at nearby enemies

primary.name: Air Lift
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 10, Set Jump Distance, Max Speed: +20, Speed: +20
primary.desc: Double jump skill
details: Can be assigned a Key Slot or activated by pressing jump twice<bp_While in the air, pressing together with the Up Arrow Key will perform a vertical jump_>

primary.name: Scale Skin
primary.shortDesc: DEF: +200, Knockback Resistance: +40%

primary.name: Dragon Slash I
primary.shortDesc: Additional 40% bonus to Dragon Slash damage

primary.name: Impact Wave
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 17, Damage: 270%, Mobs Hit: 8, Number of Attacks: 2
primary.desc: Fire a shockwave forward
details: [Combo]: Attack -> Up Arrow (together) + <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/dragon-link.png} tip={Dragon Link (Beginner Skill)}>

primary.name: Piercing Blaze
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 20, Monsters Hit: 12, Damage: 250%, Stun Chance: 80%, Stun Duration: 2 sec
primary.desc: Dash forward while pushing enemies back
details: Has a chance to stun enemies

primary.name: Tempest Blades
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 30, Swords Summoned: 3 per 0.3 sec\nUse Tempest Blades: Charge after summoning to send the swords at the enemy and deal 300% damage with 3 attacks.\nFinal Form: Number of Attacks: +1
primary.desc: While toggled, periodically summon swords that upon activating, will seek out and strike nearby enemies
details: Pressing <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/tempest-blades-charge.png} tip={Tempest Blades: Charge (2nd Job)}> will activate the swords to strike
During <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/final-form.png} tip={Final Form (3rd Job)}>, swords will gain 1 additional number of attacks
Prioritizes enemies with the highest Max HP first

primary.name: Tempest Blades: Charge
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 30, Discharges the swords summoned by Tempest Blades.\nCooldown: 10 sec
primary.desc: Activate swords summoned by <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/tempest-blades.png} tip={Tempest Blades (2nd Job)}> to seek out nearby enemies
details: Can be used while casting other skills

primary.name: Blaze On
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 30, Duration: 240 sec, Attack Power: +20, Attack Speed: +2
primary.desc: Increases Attack Speed (by 2 stages) and grants flat Attack

primary.name: Sword Mastery
primary.shortDesc: Two-Handed Sword Mastery: +50%, Attack Speed: +1

primary.name: Defender Mode I
primary.shortDesc: Defense: Additional +200

primary.name: Attacker Mode I
primary.shortDesc: Attack Power: +10, Critical Rate: +2%, Boss Damage: +5%
details: Increases Attack, %Crit Rate, and %Boss Damage provided

primary.name: Dragon Slash II
primary.shortDesc: Additional 70% bonus to Dragon Slash damage

primary.name: Wing Beat
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 35, Summon Duration: 15 sec, Max Enemies Hit: 8, Damage: 200%, Max Number of Attacks: 40\nSlow Chance: 40%, Slow Duration: 5 sec
primary.desc: Summon a moving whirlwind that damages enemies it collides with
details: Up to 2 whirlwinds can be active at once
The whirlwind will disappear after a set distance or has attacked enemies a set number of times

primary.name: Pressure Chain
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 30, Penetrates then pulls 8 enemies dealing 280% damage 2 times, Stun Chance: 95%
primary.desc: Strike forward while pulling in enemies with a chance to stun

primary.name: Final Form
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 40, Duration: 60, Final Damage: +10%, Power Stance Chance: +100%. Ignores enemies' attack-ignoring and attack-reflecting effects.\nAfter 4th Job Advancement: Final Damage: +15%
primary.desc: Transform into your true form
details: Attacks are enhanced and you gain increased %Final Damage and 100% Knockback Resistance<bp_In 4th Job, the %Final Damage bonus is increased_>
While transformed, attacks ignore Attack Ignore and Damage Reflect
You can teleport a short distance by the Skill Key and an Arrow Key for the direction you want to go together

primary.name: Stone Dragon
primary.shortDesc:
MP Cost: 35, Duration: 60 sec, Max Enemies Hit: 8, Damage: 400%
Summons a dragon statue that attacks 3 times
with a 75% chance to Slow enemies, excluding Boss Monsters, for 3 sec
Damage increases 50% when attacking normal enemies
primary.desc: Summon a stationary statue that attacks and pulls in nearby enemies
details: Also has a chance to slow enemies hit (excluding boss monsters)

primary.name: Cursebite
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 40, Duration: 240 sec, Abnormal Status Resistance: +60, Elemental Resistance: +60%\nWhen attacking a monster with a status ailment, final damage +8%\nFinal damage increase when attacking a monster with a status ailment boosted to 18% during Final Form.
primary.desc: Increases Abnormal Status Resistance, %Elemental Resistance, and %Final Damage to enemies with Abnormal Statuses
details: When transformed, the %Final Damage increase is boosted

primary.name: Catalyze
primary.shortDesc: Attack Power: +30%, Critical Rate: +20%, Final Damage: +33%

primary.name: Self Recovery
primary.shortDesc: Every 4 sec, restores 5% HP and MP even in combat.

primary.name: Defender Mode II
primary.shortDesc: Defense: Additional +200\n3% of max HP restored when using Dragon Link skills.
details: Now when toggled, attacks activated using <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/dragon-link.png} tip={Dragon Link (Beginner Skill)}> will restore some %Max HP

primary.name: Attacker Mode II
primary.shortDesc: Attack Power: +15, Critical Rate: +5%, Boss Damage: +5%\nFinal Damage additionally increased by 5% when using Dragon Link skills.
details: Increases Attack, %Crit Rate, and %Boss Damage provided
Now when toggled, attacks activated using <tt src={/class-icons/nova/kaiser/dragon-link.png} tip={Dragon Link (Beginner Skill)}> gain increased %Final Damage

primary.name: Dragon Slash III
primary.shortDesc: Additional 90% bonus to Dragon Slash damage

primary.name: Gigas Wave
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 50, Enemies Hit: 1, Damage: 330%, Number of Attacks: 9\nFinal Form: MP Cost: 60, Enemies Hit: 3, Damage: 330%, Number of Attacks: 11
primary.desc: Slash forward several times at a single enemy

primary.name: Dragon Barrage
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 50, Max Enemies Hit: 12, Damage: 550%, Number of Attacks: 7\nFinal Form: MP Cost: 60, Enemies Hit: 12, Damage: 550%, Number of Attacks: 9.\nCooldown: 5 sec.
